name: Combat of Clarity
description: An old, unused Arbiter Twin tradition of single combat when the twins disagree on a verdict, won by the twin with greater clarity.

description_citations.text: "The Chensal Twins" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The twins fight the Combat of Clarity, and Kela, seeing everything clearly, defeats Dar.
timeline.quote: Kela leapt into a spinning strike and landed in a crouch on the ground with her knee on Dar's chest and her blade at his throat.

citation.text: "The Chensal Twins" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Oct 2014.
